entries.name: ExitPlanMode
entries.description:
Use this tool when you are in plan mode and have finished writing your plan to the plan file and are ready for user approval.

## How This Tool Works
- You should have already written your plan to the plan file specified in the plan mode system message
- This tool does NOT take the plan content as a parameter - it will read the plan from the file you wrote
- This tool simply signals that you're done planning and ready for the user to review and approve
- The user will see the contents of your plan file when they review it

## When to Use This Tool
IMPORTANT: Only use this tool when the task requires planning the implementation steps of a task that requires writing code. For research tasks where you're gathering information, searching files, reading files or in general trying to understand the codebase - do NOT use this tool.

## Before Using This Tool
Ensure your plan is complete and unambiguous:
- If you have unresolved questions about requirements or approach, use AskUserQuestion first (in earlier phases)
- Once your plan is finalized, use THIS tool to request approval

**Important:** Do NOT use AskUserQuestion to ask "Is this plan okay?" or "Should I proceed?" - that's exactly what THIS tool does. ExitPlanMode inherently requests user approval of your plan.

## Examples

1. Initial task: "Search for and understand the implementation of vim mode in the codebase" - Do not use the exit plan mode tool because you are not planning the implementation steps of a task.
2. Initial task: "Help me implement yank mode for vim" - Use the exit plan mode tool after you have finished planning the implementation steps of the task.
3. Initial task: "Add a new feature to handle user authentication" - If unsure about auth method (OAuth, JWT, etc.), use AskUserQuestion first, then use exit plan mode tool after clarifying the approach.

tool.description: The tool this prompt applies to

prompt.description: Semantic description of the action, e.g. "run tests", "install dependencies"

input.plan:
# Capture the Frag — Multi-format Editor Plan

## Context
`index.html` is a single-file vanilla-JS app: a `contenteditable` rich editor that serializes to Markdown (`toMarkdown()`, index.html:690-822) and saves via the File System Access API into `<app folder>/raw-documents/` (`getAppFolder()` / `save()`, index.html:862-973). All logic lives in one IIFE with no clear boundaries between the editor, toolbar, and app shell. The UI is roomy (40/56px editor padding, 38px buttons), the save folder sits at the bottom and can't be changed, and only Markdown is supported. Pasting always drops to plain text (index.html:676).

Goal: refactor the editor into a documented `FragEditor` class backed by pluggable **format adapters** (Markdown, HTML, Text, Google Doc) and three **view modes** (Preview, Edit, Preview/Edit). Add paste-based format detection, per-format toolbars, a top status bar showing format and save folder, and a compact layout. Before any of that, add a global Claude Code hook that saves plan-mode transcripts into `documents/`.

---

## Step 0: Global rule to save plan-mode transcripts

**Answer to the implied question:** a CLAUDE.md rule can't do this without using tokens. To follow it, the model would have to read and re-emit the transcript, which costs a lot and risks changing the text. A **hook** costs zero model tokens. The harness runs a script, and the script copies the session's JSONL byte-for-byte.

- **`~/.claude/settings.json`**: add a `PostToolUse` hook with matcher `ExitPlanMode`. It runs `node "~/.claude/hooks/save-plan-transcript.mjs"`. Node is already present because the context-mode plugin uses it, and Node works the same on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- **`~/.claude/hooks/save-plan-transcript.mjs`** (new, about 40 lines):
  1. Read the hook JSON from stdin: `transcript_path`, `cwd`, `session_id`, `tool_input.plan`.
  2. Title = first `# ` heading in `tool_input.plan`, slugified (lowercase, `[^a-z0-9]+` → `-`). Fallback: `plan-<session_id[0..8]>`.
  3. Target dir = `$CLAUDE_PLAN_DOCS_DIR` if set (this is the "other folder specified" override, settable per repo in `.claude/settings.json` → `env`). Otherwise `<git rev-parse --show-toplevel>/documents`, falling back to `<cwd>/documents`. Create the directory if missing.
  4. `fs.copyFileSync(transcript_path, <dir>/YYYY.MM.dd.<title>.md)`. This is a raw copy with no rewriting. Re-approving a plan in the same session overwrites the same file.
  5. Exit 0 silently. Never block the tool.
- **`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`**: add one line saying plan transcripts are auto-saved to `documents/` by a hook, so Claude should not write them manually.
- After installing, run the script once by hand for **this** session, because its ExitPlanMode happens before the hook exists.

---

## Step 1: Restructure the script (requests 4, 4a)

Keep the single `index.html` with no build step, so it still works from `file://`. Reorganize the `<script>` into clearly bannered sections, in this order:

| # | Section | Contents |
|---|---------|----------|
| 1 | `CONFIG` | constants, storage keys, default format/mode |
| 2 | `UTILITIES` | `$`, `escapeHtml`, `idb*` helpers (existing), `safeStorage` (try/catch localStorage) |
| 3 | `SANITIZER` | `sanitizeHtml(html)`: DOMParser + tag/attr allowlist; strips `script`, `on*`, `javascript:` URLs; uses `Element.setHTML` when available |
| 4 | `FORMAT ADAPTERS` | one object per format implementing a common interface (below) |
| 5 | `FORMAT DETECTOR` | `detectFormat({ html, text }) → { id, confidence }` |
| 6 | `FORMAT CONVERTER (stub)` | conversion registry (request 8) |
| 7 | `class FragEditor extends EventTarget` | the editor itself; the only thing that touches the editing DOM |
| 8 | `class FormatToolbar` | renders a toolbar from the active adapter's spec |
| 9 | `class SaveFolder` | folder picking, persistence, display path |
| 10 | `APP SHELL` | title, status bar, dialogs/toast (existing), save/new, wiring |

**Format adapter interface** (each adapter is plain data plus pure functions):
```js
{
  id: 'markdown', label: 'Markdown', ext: '.md', mime: 'text/markdown',
  toolbar: [ ['undo','redo'], ['block'], ['bold','italic','strike','code','link','image'], ... ],
  render(source)    -> sanitized HTML for Preview / Preview-Edit
  serialize(rootEl) -> source string from the rich DOM (Preview/Edit → source)
  fileContent(source, title) -> what gets written to disk
  rawCommands: { bold: (ta) => wrapSelection(ta,'**'), ... }   // Edit-mode toolbar behavior
}
```
- **Markdown**: `serialize` = the existing `toMarkdown` code (index.html:690-822), moved and parameterized on a root element. `render` = a new in-file Markdown→HTML renderer. It covers the same subset the serializer emits (headings, paragraphs, emphasis, strike, inline/fenced code, nested lists, task lists, blockquotes, hr, links, images, GFM tables), so round-trips stay stable.
- **HTML**: `render` = `sanitizeHtml(source)`. `serialize` = sanitized `innerHTML` with light pretty-printing. `fileContent` wraps in a minimal `<!doctype html>` document unless the source already is one.
- **Text**: `render` = escaped text in `white-space: pre-wrap`. `serialize` = `innerText`. The rich surface uses `contenteditable="plaintext-only"`.
- **Google Doc**: Google-Docs-flavored HTML (see Open Question 6). `normalize(html)` turns the clipboard markup into semantic HTML. It unwraps `<b id="docs-internal-guid-…">`, maps `font-weight:700` → `<strong>`, `font-style:italic` → `<em>`, `text-decoration:line-through` → `<s>`, and drops `<span>`/`style` noise. After normalizing it behaves like HTML. Saved as `.html`.

**`FragEditor` public API** (everything else in the app calls only this):
```
new FragEditor(hostEl, { format, mode, placeholder })
getContent() / setContent(source, formatId?)      // source of truth = source string
getFormat() / setFormat(id, { convert = true })   // calls FormatConverter stub
getMode()   / setMode('preview' | 'edit' | 'live')
exec(commandId, arg?) / queryState(commandId)     // routes to rich or raw surface
focus(), clear(), isEmpty(), stats() -> { words, chars }
events: 'change', 'formatchange', 'modechange', 'selectionchange'
```
Internals: one host holding three surfaces, with only one visible at a time.
- `<textarea class="surface-raw">` for **Edit**: raw source in every format.
- `<div class="surface-preview">` for **Preview**: read-only `render(source)`.
- `<div contenteditable class="surface-live">` for **Preview/Edit**: WYSIWYG. On `input`, a debounced `serialize()` updates the source.

Switching modes flushes the current surface into `this.source`, then renders the new surface from it. The existing selection/execCommand helpers (`restoreSelection`, `closestInEditor`, `toggleInlineCode`, `toggleLink`, `setBlock`, index.html:515-649) become private methods for the rich surface. Raw-surface commands use `textarea.focus(); document.execCommand('insertText', …)` so native undo keeps working.

---

## Step 2: Top status bar, format indicator, mode switch, save folder (requests 1, 5, 6)

Replace the bottom `.statusbar` (index.html:391-398) and `.title-hint` with one compact row under the app bar:

`[📄 title][.md] · [Format ▾ Markdown] · [Preview | Edit | Preview/Edit] ········ [📁 capture-the-frag/raw-documents] · ● Saved · 123 words`

- **Format indicator**: a `<select>` styled as a chip. Changing it calls `editor.setFormat()`. The `.ext-chip` updates from `adapter.ext`. It also updates when paste detection switches the format.
- **Mode switch**: a segmented control (`role="radiogroup"`). Shortcuts are Ctrl+Alt+1/2/3. For Text, Preview and Preview/Edit look the same, which is fine.
- **Save folder link** (`class SaveFolder`):
  - Click → `showDirectoryPicker({ id:'ctf-save', mode:'readwrite', startIn: currentHandle })`. The picked folder becomes the save folder directly; see Open Question 4.
  - **Answer on "store the path cross-browser / cross-OS":** browsers never expose absolute file-system paths. That is a deliberate security rule on every browser and OS, so storing a real path is impossible. What we can store:
    - The `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` goes in **IndexedDB**. This is already done (`idbSet('appFolder')`). Handles are structured-cloneable in Chromium on Windows, macOS, Linux, and ChromeOS, and re-granting permission is one click (`ensurePermission`, index.html:886).
    - A display string goes in **localStorage**: the handle's `name`, plus the relative path from a remembered parent when available, via `parent.resolve(child)`.
  - **Firefox / Safari** don't have `showDirectoryPicker`. There the link reads "Browser downloads folder", and saving falls back to `<a download>` with a Blob. That gives every browser a working save, with the existing banner shown as an info note.
  - Keep the existing `index.html`-presence sanity check only if we keep the app-folder convention.

---

## Step 3: Cursor and placeholder (request 2)
- `.page { cursor: text }`. A `mousedown` on the page padding (outside the surface) focuses the active surface at the end of the content, so the whole card is a click target.
- Placeholder: `.surface-live.is-empty:focus::before { content: none }`. For the textarea, use the native `placeholder` with `textarea:focus::placeholder { color: transparent }`. Preview mode shows a muted "Nothing to preview" note instead.
- Keep `caret-color: var(--accent)`.

## Step 4: Compact layout (request 3)
- App bar padding `12px 24px` → `6px 12px`. `.btn` height 38 → 30, font 13px. Brand mark 32 → 24.
- `main` padding → `8px 12px 16px`. `.doc-shell` max-width 860 → `min(1100px, 100%)` to use available width.
- Merge the title field, format, mode, and status into one 36px row. Remove `.title-hint`; its text moves to the `.ext-chip` tooltip.
- Toolbar buttons 34 → 28, select 34 → 28. Make the sticky `top` a CSS variable (`--appbar-h`) instead of the hard-coded `63px` (index.html:148).
- Editor padding `40px 56px 56px` → `16px 20px 24px`. `line-height` 1.7 → 1.5, font 15px. Heading margins tightened. `min-height: calc(100vh - <chrome>)` so the editor fills the viewport.
- Dialog and toast are unchanged.

---

## Step 5: Paste detection (request 7)
`FragEditor` handles `paste` itself and calls `detectFormat({ html: cd.getData('text/html'), text: cd.getData('text/plain') })`:
1. `html` contains `docs-internal-guid` → **Google Doc**.
2. `text` parses as markup: starts with `<!doctype`/`<html`, or more than 60% of non-blank lines start with a tag → **HTML** (pasted source code).
3. A Markdown score from `text` (`^#{1,6} `, `^[-*+] `, `^\d+\. `, fences, `[x](y)`, `**x**`, `^> `, table pipes, weighted per line) ≥ threshold → **Markdown**.
4. Rich `html` present (web page, Word) → **HTML**.
5. Otherwise → **Text**.

Behavior (see Open Question 8):
- **Editor empty**: adopt the detected format. Call `setContent(normalizedSource, id)`, which updates the format chip, toolbar, and ext, and show a toast ("Detected Markdown").
- **Editor not empty, different format**: insert the fragment converted into the *current* format through the converter (HTML→MD uses the existing serializer, and any→Text uses `textContent`). The toast offers a "Switch to X" action.

## Step 6: Conversion stub (request 8)
```js
/* FORMAT CONVERTER — extension point. Register (from,to) pairs as they're built. */
const FormatConverter = {
  _fns: new Map(),
  register(from, to, fn) { this._fns.set(`${from}>${to}`, fn); },
  canConvert(from, to) { return from === to || this._fns.has(`${from}>${to}`); },
  convert(source, from, to) {
    if (from === to) return source;
    const fn = this._fns.get(`${from}>${to}`);
    if (!fn) { console.info(`[convert] ${from}→${to} not implemented`); return null; } // TODO
    return fn(source);
  },
};
```
`editor.setFormat(id)` calls `convert`. If it returns `null`, a dialog asks: "Conversion from X to Y isn't available yet. Keep the text as-is and reinterpret it as Y?" The format `<select>` is the only trigger, so the same path also serves a future clickable chip or menu. Future targets such as PDF (`window.print()` with a print stylesheet) or Google Drive upload register here too.

## Step 7: Toolbars per format (request 9)
Declarative item registry: `{ id, label, icon, kind: 'button'|'toggle'|'select', rich(editor), raw(textarea) }`. `FormatToolbar` rebuilds on `formatchange`/`modechange`. In **Preview** mode the toolbar collapses to Copy and Select All. In **Edit** mode, items without a `raw` handler are hidden.

| Format | Groups (left → right) | Edit (raw) mode behavior |
|---|---|---|
| **Markdown** | Undo/Redo · Block (Normal, H1–H3, Quote, Code block) · Bold, Italic, Strike, Inline code, Link, Image · Bullet, Numbered, Task list · HR, Table | Wraps/prefixes syntax (`**`, `` ` ``, `# `, `- `, `- [ ] `, fenced block, table skeleton) |
| **HTML** | Undo/Redo · Block (P, H1–H6, Quote, Pre) · Bold, Italic, Underline, Strike, Sub/Sup, Code, Link, Image · Bullet, Numbered, Indent/Outdent · Align L/C/R · HR, Table · Clear formatting | Wraps selection in tags; adds a **Prettify** button |
| **Text** | Undo/Redo · Soft wrap toggle · Monospace toggle · Case (UPPER / lower / Title) · Trim trailing whitespace | Same commands (one surface) |
| **Google Doc** | Undo/Redo · Styles (Normal, Title, Subtitle, H1–H3) · Bold, Italic, Underline, Strike · Text color, Highlight · Link, Image · Align · Bullet, Numbered, Checklist, Indent · Clear formatting | Shows normalized HTML; uses the HTML raw commands |

`aria-pressed` state reuses the existing `updateToolbar` logic (index.html:549), delegated to `editor.queryState(id)`.

## Step 8: Save
`save()` uses `SaveFolder.getHandle()` and writes `adapter.fileContent(editor.getContent(), title)` to `title + adapter.ext`. The overwrite confirm, dirty state, and Ctrl+S stay as they are. If the format changes, the title stays and the extension follows the format.

---

- `~/.claude/settings.json`, `~/.claude/hooks/save-plan-transcript.mjs` (new), `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`: Step 0.

# Capture the Frag — Multi-format Editor Plan

## Context
`index.html` is a single-file vanilla-JS app: a `contenteditable` rich editor that serializes to Markdown (`toMarkdown()`, index.html:690-822) and saves via the File System Access API into `<app folder>/raw-documents/` (`getAppFolder()` / `save()`, index.html:862-973). The UI is roomy (40/56px editor padding, 38px buttons), the save folder sits at the bottom and can't be changed, and only Markdown is supported. Pasting always drops to plain text (index.html:676).

Goal: refactor the editor into a documented `FragEditor` class backed by pluggable **format adapters** (Markdown, HTML, Text, Google Doc) and three **view modes** (Preview, Edit, Preview/Edit). Add paste-based format detection, per-format toolbars, a top status bar showing format and save folder, and a compact layout. ---

## Step 0: Global rule to save plan-mode transcripts

**Answer to the implied question:** a CLAUDE.md rule can't do this without using tokens. To follow it, the model would have to read and re-emit the transcript, which costs a lot and risks changing the text. A **hook** costs zero model tokens. The harness runs a script, and the script copies the session's JSONL byte-for-byte.

- **`~/.claude/settings.json`**: add a `PostToolUse` hook with matcher `ExitPlanMode`. It runs `node "~/.claude/hooks/save-plan-transcript.mjs"`. Node is already present because the context-mode plugin uses it, and Node works the same on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- **`~/.claude/hooks/save-plan-transcript.mjs`** (new, about 40 lines):
  1. Read the hook JSON from stdin: `transcript_path`, `cwd`, `session_id`, `tool_input.plan`.
  2. Title = first `# ` heading in `tool_input.plan`, slugified (lowercase, `[^a-z0-9]+` → `-`). Fallback: `plan-<session_id[0..8]>`.
  3. Target dir = `$CLAUDE_PLAN_DOCS_DIR` if set (this is the "other folder specified" override, settable per repo in `.claude/settings.json` → `env`). Otherwise `<git rev-parse --show-toplevel>/documents`, falling back to `<cwd>/documents`. Create the directory if missing.
  4. `fs.copyFileSync(transcript_path, <dir>/YYYY.MM.dd.<title>.md)`. This is a raw copy with no rewriting. Re-approving a plan in the same session overwrites the same file.
  5. Exit 0 silently. Never block the tool.
- **`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`**: add one line saying plan transcripts are auto-saved to `documents/` by a hook, so Claude should not write them manually.
- After installing, run the script once by hand for **this** session, because its ExitPlanMode happens before the hook exists.

---

| # | Section | Contents |
|---|---------|----------|
| 1 | `CONFIG` | constants, storage keys, default format/mode |
| 2 | `UTILITIES` | `$`, `escapeHtml`, `idb*` helpers (existing), `safeStorage` (try/catch localStorage) |
| 3 | `SANITIZER` | `sanitizeHtml(html)`: DOMParser + tag/attr allowlist; strips `script`, `on*`, `javascript:` URLs; uses `Element.setHTML` when available |
| 4 | `FORMAT ADAPTERS` | one object per format implementing a common interface (below) |
| 5 | `FORMAT DETECTOR` | `detectFormat({ html, text }) → { id, confidence }` |
| 6 | `FORMAT CONVERTER (stub)` | conversion registry (request 8) |
| 7 | `class FragEditor extends EventTarget` | the editor itself; the only thing that touches the editing DOM |
| 8 | `class FormatToolbar` | renders a toolbar from the active adapter's spec |
| 9 | `class SaveFolder` | folder picking, persistence, display path |

**Format adapter interface** (each adapter is plain data plus pure functions):
```js
{
  id: 'markdown', label: 'Markdown', ext: '.md', mime: 'text/markdown',
  toolbar: [ ['undo','redo'], ['block'], ['bold','italic','strike','code','link','image'], ... ],

  fileContent(source, title) -> what gets written to disk

}
```
- **Markdown**: `serialize` = the existing `toMarkdown` code (index.html:690-822), moved and parameterized on a root element. `render` = a new in-file Markdown→HTML renderer. - **Text**: `render` = escaped text in `white-space: pre-wrap`. `serialize` = `innerText`. The rich surface uses `contenteditable="plaintext-only"`.

**`FragEditor` public API** (everything else in the app calls only this):
```
new FragEditor(hostEl, { format, mode, placeholder })
getContent() / setContent(source, formatId?)      // source of truth = source string
getFormat() / setFormat(id, { convert = true })   // calls FormatConverter stub
getMode()   / setMode('preview' | 'edit' | 'live')
exec(commandId, arg?) / queryState(commandId)     // routes to rich or raw surface
focus(), clear(), isEmpty(), stats() -> { words, chars }
events: 'change', 'formatchange', 'modechange', 'selectionchange'
```
Internals: one host holding three surfaces, with only one visible at a time.
- `<textarea class="surface-raw">` for **Edit**: raw source in every format.
- `<div class="surface-preview">` for **Preview**: read-only `render(source)`.
